title: Product of Array Except Self
summary: Build an output array of the same length.

contractDetails.constraints: 2–100,000 integers, each between −30 and 30. Every prefix product, suffix product and required output fits a signed 32-bit integer.

statement: Build an output array of the same length. At zero-based position i, store the product of the inputs at every position other than i. Keep the input order in the result. Use linear time and avoid division.

examples.explanation: The first result is 5 × 3. Each later result excludes its own position.
Only the product at the zero's position leaves the zero out.
Each product includes at least one zero.

constraints: 2–100,000 integers, each between −30 and 30. Every prefix product, suffix product and required output fits a signed 32-bit integer.
hints: Conceptual: The factors for a position fall on its left or right.
Directional: Use the result array to save products of the values strictly to the left.
Implementation: Scan from right to left with a running suffix product. Multiply the stored value before adding the current element to the suffix.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space, excluding the result. The two passes each use one running product.
